clips.title: The story
paras: Steelgrill's Tools are a specialized set of mechanic implements requisitioned for Beldin Steelgrill, the master technician of Steelgrill's Depot. Renowned for pushing siege engines—and his own equipment—to their limits, Beldin frequently breaks gear and relies on shipments from nearby Kharanos to keep his workshop running.

Beldin Steelgrill is widely regarded as one of the finest siege engine technicians in Dun Morogh, but his aggressive repair style is infamous among local merchants. Working tirelessly on armored tanks and mechanical contraptions, Beldin tends to destroy delicate equipment almost as fast as it can be forged. Between snapping arclight spanners and stripping fang-ratchets, the mechanic is constantly placing fresh orders in Kharanos to keep his repair benches stocked.

This particular delivery of tools is vital for keeping Ironforge's war machines operational. At his depot northeast of Kharanos, Beldin is actively servicing combat vehicles for seasoned drivers like Pilot Stonegear. Without freshly supplied wrenches and ratchets, critical siege engines would sit half-assembled in the snow, leaving both the depot and local defenses stalled.
